column3: Shirley near Jason's house, Key Lento; buy Salty Squid rum at Three Sheets Liquor.
column4: After Gear Up / Lab Fees / Just a Scratch / Unwanted Attention, help Shirley before Tourist Trap. Buy rum BEFORE asking the shop about strange bird noises (the exotic-animal shootout can shut it). Return to Shirley for reported Focus/criminal-profile benefit. Chapter 1 MISSABLE.

column3: The Rusty Anchor, Key Lento. Cal texts after Day Release, before Swamped.
column4: Say yes to drinks with Cal and Rhonda, then DRIVE CAL HOME. Declining twice or abandoning him fails. Later Cal texts: the bar sells a white Rusty Anchor T-shirt and cap. Chapter 1 ONLY; reward is the option to BUY clothes. GPS map: Rusty Anchor bar venue for the optional mission.

column3: Shirley's neighbor Peggy's house across the water in Key Lento; scooter beside the driveway stairs.
column4: After Get Shirley's Rum, wait roughly a day for Shirley to call Jason. Take Peggy's scooter and drive it inside Shirley's porch/house. Chapter 1 ONLY: unavailable at Tourist Trap. No reward reported.

column3: Gellhorn Outfitters on west Port Gellhorn beachside.
column4: Lucia gets this automatic side mission after Girls' Trip. Retrieve weapons already stored in locker (free), or buy a gun. Walk out armed to finish; no separate cash reward. GPS map: Gellhorn Outfitters store venue for the optional mission.

column3: Read pilot flyer beside Starlet Motel office, then go to McKittrick Farm about a mile east.
column4: Lucia: (1) fly Kyle's crop duster over field, three passes ($400 reported); (2) obtain chemicals from guarded compound ($1,000 reported); (3) finish Buddy? police standoff in Chapter 3 ($5,000 reported if helping police). Later steps arrive by text; payouts depend on choices. For the chemical delivery, wait for Kyle's text then visit FarmFix on Chastity Avenue north of Belville. Inspect the van. Negotiate > Pay less > Pay now costs $3,000; Negotiate > Pay Later > Give Collateral uses Kyle's plane and costs nothing upfront (reported). Drive the van into the barn by the silo. Eat the offered strawberry for the reported max stamina upgrade; later berries give temporary effects. $1,000 payment is separate. GPS map: Starlet Motel flyer starting point; McKittrick Farm is a separate destination.

column3: Northern Lummox County near Mount Kalaga; Jason receives Bret text after Coffee Break.
column4: JASON ONLY. Meet Bret alone after Coffee Break; take the Killtelligence SM-69 (weapon ID 435). Study and track deer, aim for head or heart for Good or Pristine carcass quality, and transport kills by truck. Bret texts each Target Deck after the prior delivery; see Activities > Bret Target Decks for documented hunts. First reward ~$500 reported. After Veteran Hunted, watch for Bret's rare-animal clues in Activities > Snapmatic Animals. See the Legendary Animals checklist for nine clue hunts and two other rare creatures. Use Focus (L3+R3) to inspect vitals, best weapon and value; Bret buys whole carcasses after this mission. Green dollar icon indicates available drop-off.

column3: Salton, Vice City: after Bumper to Bumper and Yago's delayed text; Jason only.
column4: TIME-LIMITED pink hourglass. Meet Santiago, select Freeway Run (second race), rent a car, finish race against Yago. First-place payout reported $3,800, varies by finish. DO THIS promptly when text arrives; required before final Brother to Brother. Separate from initial Join a Street Race. GPS map: Salton street-race venue; select the timed Freeway Run event.

column3: Sundown Private Airfield, Leonard County. Pete calls Jason after Pool Day.
column4: JASON ONLY. Start Passing the Torch: enter hangar red door backroom, take Pete's KZ-59 from table (weapon ID 442); safe 3718 is separate. Fly cargo drops and return plane. Later Backseat Pilot and Pete's Deliveries follow. Initial $12,000 guide-reported.

column3: Thrillbilly Mud Club, north Kelly County
column4: Begin Billy strand: Check Out the Mud Club; unlocks other Mud Club races. GPS map: Thrillbilly Mud Club venue; meet Billy to start the mission.

column3: Port Gellhorn. Wait for Billy to contact you after Thrillbillies.
column4: Join Billy with either character and follow his crew on the dirt bike. Finish the armored van job and follow Billy back. Reported payout $2,000.

column3: Behind the Malibu, Ocean Beach. Wait for Billy to contact you in Chapter 3 after Twist Wrist.
column4: Bring Jason or Lucia solo. Follow Billy into the jewelry store and leave in the van. Reported payout $12,000. This is a story job with Billy.

column3: Ambrosia Police Department impound, Kelly County.
column4: After Mall Rats, wait for Billy to call, then reply to Wyman's text. Take the police Impaler, lose the police and deliver it to the tunnel. Either character can start.

column3: Thrillbilly Mud Club, Kelly County. Follow Billy's text after The Impaler.
column4: Return to the mud club for Billy's finale. The reported reward is $10,000 and The Lone Rider trophy or achievement.

column3: Andy's new house, Belville. Wait for a call and address text as Lucia after Mami Knows Best and Car Service.
column4: Finish the three Climbing the Cellerichain deliveries. Andy gives Lucia the Pure Manifestick and Cellerica cap welcome package.

column3: Lucia's phone, anywhere. Wait for Andy after finishing all three Cellerichain parts.
column4: Pay the reported $5,000 initiation fee through BuckMe. Switch to Lucia to receive the call.

column3: Andy Cellerica initiation, Lucia only
column4: After paying Andy's fee, wait for his text as Lucia. At the Belville Cellerica campus, look outside Conference Hall B for the green Cellerica Caddy that Andy introduces.

column3: Vice City. Cecilia sends the location to Lucia after Peach!, following an in-game delay.
column4: Recover the marked Cellerica van and drive it to Cecilia's warehouse. Reported payout $1,800 through BuckMe.

column3: Start at the Paper Boys warehouse after Cecilia contacts Lucia. The mission continues at Cecilia's mansion.
column4: Finish Read the Label first. Complete the warehouse sequence and find Cecilia at her mansion. Reported reward $10,000 and the Road to Rehabilitation trophy or achievement.

column3: After Boobie Time, look for Yasmani's job markers at Casa de Empeno, Richardson Jewelry and Donovan Banks & Co.
column4: Either character can take the jobs. Objective items unlock the Snap Gun and paid garage pickups. The reported objective-item payout is $20,000 plus any other proceeds.

column3: Yasmani ATM jobs
column4: Complete the ATM side-job strand; exact ATM list not independently published.

column4: Rob 2 payday loans to unlock security-van tip service.

column3: Yasmani side job
column4: Tail the Security Van. Later pay for tips to attempt the large vaults.

column4: Take Out Kitty Litter: start lab-closure strand.

column3: Grayson, Lummox County. Jason receives the follow-up after closing enough Kitty Litter labs.
column4: Meet Tyrone at the motel and finish his lab operation. Reported reward $10,000 and the Spin On This! trophy or achievement.

column3: Dunk robbery tip marker
column4: Guide reports optional robberies from Dunk; use in-game markers for individual tips.

column3: Gambit Bay, Mariana County, after Feng Shui. Play as Jason.
column4: Catch a stoplight parrotfish weighing more than 2 lb for Cal. The guide reports a Focus increase and the Baited My Tackle trophy or achievement.

column3: Heathcliff Heights party at the Y Hotel, Ocean Beach, during Pool Day. Attend with one playable character.
column4: Meet Eddie at the elevator. The published guide reports that agreeing to pay him costs $50,000. Refusing avoids the payment.

column3: Hamlet, Vice-Dale County, after Lawyer Up. Lucia only.
column4: Time-sensitive. Pick up Shayna and drive her home. The outcome and reported valuables depend on the choices at Raph's house.

column3: Cafe Orquidea, Ocean Beach, after VCIA Takedown.
column4: Either character can meet Yasmani's marker. Follow the security van, enter the bank and finish the vault tutorial to unlock eight large-bank vault jobs.

column3: Salton, Vice City: after Dealer's Choice; Manuel texts Jason with the Hit n Run VC street-race marker.
column4: Open Yago questline. Rent a car and finish Join a Street Race. Introduces Yago; after a few in-game days unlocks Bumper to Bumper (ID 1444), then timed race (ID 1413), then Brother to Brother (ID 1445). GPS map: Salton Hit N Run VC race venue; follow the quest marker.

column3: Little Cuba, Vice City: Yago's street shop; Jason only. Wait several in-game days after Join a Street Race.
column4: If marker is locked, sleep/return later. Drive Yago's 1990 Annis Elegy to Euroform Automotive; select Pro Builds > Full Kits > Custom Street Racing Build, then Performance > Boost > Nitrous Boost. Yago pays. Finish race, lose cops and meet Yago north of Vice City. Reward $500. Later he texts about the MISSABLE limited race ID 1413.

column3: El Rincon Notorio restaurant BACK DOOR, Little Cuba, Vice City. Yago texts after earlier races; Jason only.
column4: Final Yago mission, after limited Race Against Yago (ID 1413); delayed a few in-game days. Back him at deal in west Vice City, take bag, fight through gang and follow his car. End choice does not save Yago. Reward: KEEP his custom anime-wrapped Annis Yago's Elegy, Standout ID 3603; garage it or sell at Pay n Spray. Bag contains marked bills to fence; no direct cash payout. Counts toward Strangers & Freaks.

column3: Freddie's compound on the north shore of Lake Leonida, Leonard County. Either character.
column4: Find the east-side route into the compound and speak to Freddie over the intercom on the first visit. Wait for his text, return for the marked retest and follow him inside. Reported $10,000 and credit toward Strangers & Freaks.

column3: Meet the roadside protesters south of Vice City International Airport. Noah's follow-up is in northwest Southside by the river.
column4: Give Noah your details and wait for his text. Go alone as Jason or Lucia. Photograph the animals with the phone and follow Noah until you deliver the cage.

column3: Vice City Oceanarium, Catalan Key. Speak to Rosebud among the protesters, then meet at her marker south of the buildings.
column4: Give Rosebud your details and wait for her message. Use Jason or Lucia solo. Follow her through the Oceanarium and drive the orca transport to the marked drop-off.

column3: Watson Bay, Mariana County. Meet Tyler as Lucia after Bring Out the Chimp and Sisters of the Sea.
column4: Follow Tyler to the fracking site. Complete the valve and drill objectives, then leave with him. His follow-up opens the final Dodos mission.

column3: Emerald Springs park, Kelly County. Lucia only, after Twin Flames.
column4: Follow the green arrows toward the glass building on the park island. Take the egg to Jeff and finish the marked stops with the dodo before delivering it to Yvonne. Reported payout $5,000.

column3: Park at the south end of Ocean Beach. A poster in the Bayside Apartment lobby points to the event.
column4: Talk to the stuntman in white as Jason or Lucia. Set up the stunt and meet the AudaCity engineer afterward to start Papa Audacity's strand.

column3: La Perle, Vice City. After The Unknown Stuntman, wait for the message and return as the same character.
column4: Meet the AudaCity engineer. Finish the marked dirt-bike tests, including the final leap, and speak to the engineer again.

column3: Peacock Bay Condominiums. After Trial by Tire, bring both Jason and Lucia to Papa Audacity's marker.
column4: Go to the roof, help with the aerial stunt and bring Papa Audacity to the medical center. The AudaCity Sandking is a reported keep-or-sell reward.

column3: Use the marked AudaCity vehicles around Vice City after Quit Your Job, Sell Your House.
column4: Finish the five dirt-bike jumps, then complete the two follow-up stunts that appear. Follow the mission markers for the full series.

column3: Sundown Airfield, Waning Sands, Leonard County. Unlocks after completing the AudaCity stunts.
column4: Meet Papa Audacity at the airfield. Follow the flight route, climb to the marked altitude and parachute onto the yacht.

column3: Neo Paloma Apartments, Tequesta. Papa Audacity sends the party invitation after Catching a Whale.
column4: Find the engineers by the elevator. Sell DacityCoin through the phone before the final jump to receive the reported payout. Finish the party escape for Strangers & Freaks credit.
